headline: Sterlite Technologies files SEBI Regulation 31(4) disclosure of substantial acquisition
sum: Sterlite Technologies Limited filed a mandatory SEBI Regulation 31(4) disclosure under the Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers (SAST) framework, signalling a threshold shareholding change requiring open offer or other disclosure obligations. Acquirer identity, stake percentage, and consideration remain undisclosed in publicly accessible sources as of 3 July 2026.
detail: Sterlite Technologies Limited submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure to NSE on 29 June 2026, confirming a substantial shareholding event under SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011. The filing is a mandatory post-acquisition announcement; full details of the acquirer, stake acquired, and offer structure are not accessible in the PDF header or public press at the search date. This stage typically precedes an open offer announcement within 4–6 weeks if triggered above 25% threshold.
